tasks.original_prompt:
Pre-visit insurance: if the eligibility response for this patient's lab follow-up says not in force, add a registration task on that coverage and name the payer; otherwise make no changes.
Context: patient MRN SYN-80fc5ca3ed (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-09-13, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The lab visit is the Appointment with status booked whose description is 'Laboratory follow-up' and whose start is after the as-of date. The eligibility check is the CoverageEligibilityResponse whose servicedDate equals the lab visit's start date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "in_force": ..., "payer": ..., "task_created": ...}: visit_date (YYYY-MM-DD), in_force (boolean: the response's first insurance entry's inforce) and payer (string: name of the Organization that is the payor of the Coverage that insurance entry references). Only when in_force is false, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference and $coverage with that Coverage: {"resourceType": "Task", "status": "requested", "intent": "order", "for": {"reference": "$patient"}, "focus": {"reference": "$coverage"}}. task_created (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Appointment, the response, the Coverage and the Organization), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.

Interval update for this patient: lab results and orders placed after the last follow-up visit.
Context: patient MRN SYN-80fc5ca3ed (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-09-13, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The last follow-up visit is the most recent Encounter with status finished, a type coding with code followup-coordination and a period start on or before the as-of date; call its start date the visit date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "new_results": [...], "new_orders": [...]}. new_results has one entry for every Observation with status final or corrected, a code.coding code in this list: 718-7, 4548-4, 2160-0, 3016-3, 35200-5, 35217-9, and an effective date after the visit date and on or before the as-of date, sorted by date then code, each with exactly these keys: code (string), date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). new_orders has one entry for every ServiceRequest authored after the visit date and on or before the as-of date, sorted by ordered then code, each with exactly these keys: code (string: first code.coding code), ordered (string: authoredOn date, YYYY-MM-DD) and status (string). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Encounter, each listed Observation and each listed ServiceRequest), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.
